mentions.name: Birdfeeder
mentions.description: A bookmark reminder and manager for social media platforms including Twitter (X), Bluesky, Nostr, and Mastodon, helping users save and revisit bookmarks across these services. The project was originally released years ago, shut down during the X API changes, and has now been revived with support for additional services.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a Twitter (X), Bluesky, Nostr and Mastodon bookmark reminder and manager called https://getbirdfeeder.com. It's a project I've released many years ago but had to shut down during the X API changes. I've now revived it and supported more services.
